final: SELECT AVG(group_ratio) AS average_file_size_to_length_ratio, AVG(track_count) AS average_track_count, AVG(group_ratio - overall_ratio) AS average_difference FROM (SELECT media_group.group_ratio, media_group.track_count, overall.overall_ratio FROM (SELECT MediaType.Name AS media_type_name, AVG(CAST(Track.Bytes AS REAL) / Track.Milliseconds) AS group_ratio, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track JOIN MediaType ON Track.MediaTypeId = MediaType.MediaTypeId GROUP BY MediaType.Name) AS media_group CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(group_ratio) AS overall_ratio FROM (SELECT AVG(CAST(Track.Bytes AS REAL) / Track.Milliseconds) AS group_ratio FROM Track JOIN MediaType ON Track.MediaTypeId = MediaType.MediaTypeId GROUP BY MediaType.Name)) AS overall WHERE media_group.group_ratio > overall.overall_ratio) AS kept
